name: CPI Europe AG
summary: CPI Europe AG, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the purchasing, leasing, realization, acquisition, and developing of properties in Austria, Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Romania, Slovakia, Croatia, Serbia, Slovenia, and Italy. The company manages and develops retail and office properties under the myhive, STOP SHOP, and VIVO! Brands. Its portfolio includes office buildings, retail and residential properties, and hotels. In addition, the company owns and operates hotels. The company was formerly known as IMMOFINANZ AG and changed its name to CPI Europe AG in March 2025. CPI Europe AG was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.
